page.layout: Running head at top, page number right; heading block "SEQVENS IN LAVDEM virginis."; two parallel verse columns (left and right) of hymn lines; below, centred short lines "ET:" and verse; "ET EX MISSALI PARISIENSI." heading with verse; "EX ORATIONE, QVÆ DICENDA sit die Sabbathi, in honorem Mariæ." heading with lines; signature line "M 5" and catchword "Indefi-" at the foot.

main_text.head: SEQVENS IN LAVDEM virginis.
main_text.p:
Pulchrior sideribus,
Et præ mulieribus
Cunctis benedicta,
Placa tuum filium,
Et purga fidelium
Omnium delicta.
In te pluit,
In te fluit
Deus suam gratiam:

Ergo tuæ
Nobis plue
Gratię clementiam.
Ad beati
Tui nati
Transferas præsetiā.
Et cunctorum
Delictorum
Cófer indulgentiā.
main_text.head: ET EX MISSALI PARISIENSI.
EX ORATIONE, QVÆ DICENDA sit die Sabbathi, in honorem Mariæ.

page.notes: The verse lines in the two columns are set in parallel; the first line of the right column is "Ergo tuæ". Some words are faint or damaged by stains and show-through; readings of the hymn lines are approximate where the scan is worn.
